fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: How a house goes from first sketch to the keys in your hand

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Every project at Atelier Nord follows the same five stages, so you always know what comes next and what it costs.

default.title: Listening
default.text: We visit the site, walk through how you live today and agree on a brief and a budget ceiling.

default.title: Concept
default.text: Three hand-drawn directions, then one scale model we refine with you over two workshops.

default.title: Planning and permits
default.text: Detailed drawings, structural engineering and the permit application, all handled by our team.

default.title: Build
default.text: We choose the contractor with you and visit the site every week until the last tile is set.

default.title: Handover
default.text: A walkthrough, a binder with every material and supplier, and a check-in one year later.
